jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee, not an entry-level paid role — it seeks senior specialists on climate-justice securitisation and defender criminalisation, well beyond the candidate's early-career profile, and is effectively an advisory (likely unpaid/voluntary) capacity rather than a genuine paid vacancy. The human-rights/security subject is interesting, but the seniority mismatch is a hard blocker.

jobs.title: MS Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: Senior title requiring at least 4 years of industry experience plus qualification as a third-party ISO auditor and a technical engineering/quality background — none of which the candidate has, so multiple hard disqualifiers apply. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's research, law and geopolitical interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks recognised expertise in criminalisation of defenders and regional advocacy, which is a senior/specialist appointment the candidate does not meet. It is also effectively a speculative expert-panel posting rather than a concrete paid vacancy, and the Spanish-language track implies working proficiency in Spanish the candidate lacks.
